Package ru.nsu.krasnyanskii.checker

Class CheckerView

java.lang.Object
ru.nsu.krasnyanskii.checker.CheckerView
public class CheckerView extends Object
Single point of all console output for the application (SRP). No other class writes to System.out / System.err directly.
